sql.where: deleted_yn='N' AND (LOWER(application_id) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{q}),'%') OR LOWER(application_name) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{q}),'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT application_id AS applicationId, application_name AS applicationName, owner_team AS ownerTeam, current_java AS currentJava, current_spring AS currentSpring, current_was AS currentWas, build_tool AS buildTool, target_java AS targetJava, target_spring AS targetSpring, target_jakarta AS targetJakarta, risk_level AS riskLevel, notes FROM modernization_application ORDER BY application_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT application_id AS applicationId, application_name AS applicationName, owner_team AS ownerTeam, current_java AS currentJava, current_spring AS currentSpring, current_was AS currentWas, build_tool AS buildTool, target_java AS targetJava, target_spring AS targetSpring, target_jakarta AS targetJakarta, risk_level AS riskLevel, notes FROM modernization_application WHERE application_id=#{id} AND deleted_yn='N'
mapper.update: UPDATE modernization_application SET application_name=#{applicationName},owner_team=#{ownerTeam},current_java=#{currentJava},current_spring=#{currentSpring},current_was=#{currentWas},build_tool=#{buildTool},target_java=#{targetJava},target_spring=#{targetSpring},target_jakarta=#{targetJakarta},risk_level=#{riskLevel},notes=#{notes} WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND deleted_yn='N'
UPDATE modernization_application SET deleted_yn='Y' WHERE application_id=#{id} AND deleted_yn='N'

sql.where: l.deleted_yn='N' AND (LOWER(l.library_name) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{q}),'%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.group_id,'')) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{q}),'%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.artifact_id,'')) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{q}),'%')) AND l.library_type=#{type} AND l.compatibility_status=#{status} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM modernization_application_library al WHERE al.library_id=l.library_id AND al.application_id=#{appId})

mapper.sql: l.library_id AS libraryId,l.library_name AS libraryName,l.library_type AS libraryType,l.group_id AS groupId,l.artifact_id AS artifactId,l.repository_source AS repositorySource,l.current_version AS currentVersion,l.target_version AS targetVersion,l.version_policy AS versionPolicy,l.compatibility_status AS compatibilityStatus,l.owner_team AS ownerTeam,l.assessment_notes AS assessmentNotes,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM modernization_application_library al WHERE al.library_id=l.library_id) AS applicationCount
mapper.select: SELECT FROM modernization_library l ORDER BY l.library_name,l.library_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM modernization_library l WHERE l.library_id=#{id} AND l.deleted_yn='N'
mapper.update: UPDATE modernization_library SET library_name=#{libraryName},library_type=#{libraryType},group_id=#{groupId},artifact_id=#{artifactId},repository_source=#{repositorySource},current_version=#{currentVersion},target_version=#{targetVersion},version_policy=#{versionPolicy},compatibility_status=#{compatibilityStatus},owner_team=#{ownerTeam},assessment_notes=#{assessmentNotes} WHERE library_id=#{libraryId} AND deleted_yn='N'
UPDATE modernization_library SET deleted_yn='Y' WHERE library_id=#{id} AND deleted_yn='N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO modernization_application_library(application_id,library_id,used_version) VALUES(#{appId},#{libraryId},#{version}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE used_version=VALUES(used_version)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM modernization_application_library WHERE application_id=#{appId} AND library_id=#{libraryId}
